description:
Our proposed works for 19 The Common is driven by a deep respect for the architectural heritage and distinct character of Ealing’s local landscape. We recognise that this property sits within a row of homes defined by specific historical proportions and aesthetic rhythms; as such, our design is not merely an expansion, it is a sensitive restoration of visual balance. By meticulously referencing the materiality and period features of the neighbouring properties, we aim to ensure the renovation appears as a seamless, integral part of the original structure rather than a modern addition. Our passion lies in a home that fits it location and uplifting the property to a sustainable energy-efficient home, creating a more symmetrical & aesthetically pleasing streetscape that honours the history of the area while contributing to its long-term architectural vitality.

Addition of a New Storey
Construction of an additional upper floor above the existing two-storey dwelling to accommodate a principal bedroom suite comprising a bedroom, dressing room, and en-suite bathroom. The extension will be integrated into the existing building envelope with materials and architectural detailing to match or complement the host property. As part of the overall enhancement strategy, the external finish of the dwelling will be rendered in white to reflect the prevailing character of neighbouring properties and the majority of homes along The Common. This approach will ensure visual cohesion within the streetscape and reinforce the architectural rhythm of the road.

Single-Storey Rear Extension
Erection of a single-storey rear extension projecting 2.8 metres beyond the existing rear elevation to enlarge the kitchen and significantly improve internal layout and functionality. The extension will remain subordinate in scale to the principal dwelling and will be constructed using materials consistent with the proposed rendered finish. The design will maintain appropriate garden depth and preserve neighbouring residential amenity.

Demolition of Existing Garage and Reconstruction 
Demolition of the existing detached garage within the rear garden and construction of a new detached ancillary building of approximately 1.5 storeys in height. The replacement structure will provide a gym at ground floor level and office space at mezzanine/upper level. It will remain incidental to the main dwelling and will be designed to be architecturally sympathetic to the principal house, incorporating a refined material palette and detailing aligned with the use of London stock brick in the area.

The proposed works represent a sympathetic and considered enhancement of 19 The Common. By close matching of the materials and proportions of the neighbouring property, the project will bring a sense of symmetry to the row of homes. We believe this cohesive approach will provide a significant visual uplift to the area, honouring Ealing’s architectural history while creating a functional, beautiful home.
